title: Write to me
text: Fill in the form below or send a DM: what you need, how many photos and when.

title: Send your photos
text: A link via Google Drive, Dropbox or WeTransfer. Color: RAW files. Skin retouching: JPEG or TIFF. From 10 photos. Please add references.

title: Approve the result
text: For color I make several options and you choose. For retouching I do one test photo. If you have your own style, send a catalog with key edited photos. No free tests for a whole series.

title: Payment
text: Once approved, you get a payment link or bank details. I work officially.

title: Your finished photos
text: After payment I edit the whole series and deliver it within the agreed time.
